talkingWithCashier.name: Cashier
talkingWithCashier.text: (What the... this girl startled the soul out of me...)

talkingWithCashier_Post.name: Lacie
talkingWithCashier_Post.text: ...Um... Actually, just a bottle of water... please.

talkingWithCashier_Post.name: Cashier
translate: ...A bottle of water and a flan...?

talkingWithCashier_Post.name: Cashier
talkingWithCashier_Post.text: Have a seat, I'll bring it for you.

talkingWithCashier_(Green Tea).name: Lacie
talkingWithCashier_(Green Tea).text: (Which was it...? It was none of those...!)

talkingWithCashier_(Green Tea).name: Cashier
talkingWithCashier_(Green Tea).text: You still need to choose a flavor.

talkingWithCashier_(Green Tea).name: Cashier
talkingWithCashier_(Green Tea).text: ...Have you even looked at the menu?

talkingWithCashier_(Strawberry Milkshake.name: Cashier
talkingWithCashier_(Strawberry Milkshake.text: We're out of strawberries. We'll go with concentrate, okay?

talkingWithCashier_(Strawberry Milkshake.name: Cashier
talkingWithCashier_(Strawberry Milkshake.text: Unless you wanna choose something else.

talkingWithCashier_(Strawberry Milkshake.name: Lacie
talkingWithCashier_(Strawberry Milkshake.text: (What fruits are there...? I should have thought of this in advance...!)

talkingWithCashier_(Strawberry Milkshake.name: Cashier
talkingWithCashier_(Strawberry Milkshake.text: I don't have all day, you know.

talkingWithCashier_(Flan).name: Cashier
talkingWithCashier_(Flan).text: A flan, with anything on top?

talkingWithCashier_(Flan).name: Lacie
talkingWithCashier_(Flan).text: Um... just one of those on display.

talkingWithCashier_(Flan).name: Cashier
talkingWithCashier_(Flan).text: Those are just for display. Not for sale.

talkingWithCashier_(Flan).name: Cashier
talkingWithCashier_(Flan).text: You need to tell me if you want it with anything...

talkingWithCashier_(Macarons).name: Cashier
talkingWithCashier_(Macarons).text: That can be strawberry, or raspberry, or cotton candy.

talkingWithCashier_(Chocolate Eclair).name: Cashier
talkingWithCashier_(Chocolate Eclair).text: There are no chocolate eclairs left.

talkingWithCashier_(Chocolate Eclair).name: Cashier
talkingWithCashier_(Chocolate Eclair).text: Hazelnut is pretty much the same thing.

lacieToughts.name: Lacie
lacieToughts.text: (I scared the cashier and couldn't even get what I wanted...)

girlAB.name: Girl A
girlAB.text: What is it? Did you notice that girl too?

girlAB.name: Girl B
girlAB.text: Is it just me or does she seem strange to you?

girlAB.name: Girl A
girlAB.text: I was just about to say the same thing.

girlAB.name: Girl B
girlAB.text: I'd feel impolite switching tables now, but...

girlAB.name: Girl A
girlAB.text: Go go, before she curses us or something!

girlAB.name: Lacie
girlAB.text: (It's just two girls. You can put up with it.)

LadyMan.name: Man
LadyMan.text: That girl.. isn't she the daughter of the family who lives on the next block?

LadyMan.name: Man
LadyMan.text: Man... Just being around her gives me the chills.

LadyMan.name: Lady
LadyMan.text: What is it about her, I wonder?

ChildTalk.name: Child
ChildTalk.text: Mommy can we leave? That lady...

ChildTalk.name: Mother
ChildTalk.text: Shh! Don't look in her direction. Finish your food and we'll go.

ChildTalk.name: Child
ChildTalk.text: I don't want it anymore, I wanna go...

ChildTalk.name: Lady
ChildTalk.text: I've met her brother though, he was in one of my classes.

ChildTalk.name: Man
ChildTalk.text: I pity the poor people who have to share a classroom with her.

ChildTalk.name: Lady
ChildTalk.text: Imagine what her family must feel having a daughter with such a reputation.

ChildTalk.name: Man
ChildTalk.text: Oh man... and after what happened...

ChildTalk.name: Lady
ChildTalk.text: Sucks to have a broken family. They don't deserve that.

ChildTalk.name: Man
ChildTalk.text: It's probably her fault, don't you think?
